inForce.howVerified: Read from the body of the official notice of designation PDF: paragraph 4 states the Secretary of State confirmed the designations on 30.11.2023 and they 'shall come into force on 01.07.2024', and paragraph 5 states they 'shall cease to have effect on 01.07.2029', so the scheme is in force on 7 August 2026.

schemes.evidence: The official notice of designation (London Borough of Lewisham Designation of Areas for Selective Licensing 2023, signed 05/12/2023 by Cllr Will Cooper) defines the scheme as three designations covering 16 wards and expressly labels each list '(pre-May 2022 ward boundaries)': Designation one is Brockley, Catford South, Lewisham Central, New Cross, Perry Vale, Rushey Green; Designation two is Crofton Park, Evelyn, Ladywell, Lee Green, Sydenham; Designation three is Bellingham, Downham, Forest Hill, Grove Park, Whitefoot, all as delineated orange, blue and green on the map in Annex A. The stale ward names are therefore correct as published, not a transcription error, and the '18 wards' figure appears only on commercial sites, never on lewisham.gov.uk; the official Mayor and Cabinet report of 08 March 2023 states 'Ward(s) affected: 16 out of 18 wards based on pre-May 2022 ward boundaries (Telegraph Hill and Blackheath excluded)'. At paragraph 10.3 that same report records that after taking advice from the Department and expert counsel the council 'concluded that the best approach is to designate the exact geographical areas consulted on, as opposed to amending the designation to mirror the new ward boundaries', so no official restatement in the 19 current wards created by The London Borough of Lewisham (Electoral Changes) Order 2020 (SI 2020/1231, https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/1231/made) exists and none has been derived here, because that order defines the new wards only by reference to a sealed map. No street list or postcode list has been published; the council's stated substitute is the address and postcode lookup at the interactive map, where the user selects 'Community Services' then the 'Selective Licensable Area' layer and runs a 'Simple Address Search'. Ward-name matching is unsafe for this council: the legal area is a fixed geography drawn on pre-2022 boundaries, so the address checker is the only reliable test.
